additional_checks.name: agent_runs_goal_result_check
additional_checks.expression: ((goal_result IS NULL) OR (((frozen_context ->> 'authorization_revision'::text) = 'delegation/1'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['done'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND (jsonb_typeof(goal_result) = 'object'::text) AND ((goal_result ->> 'status'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['completed'::text, 'partial'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'unknown'::text]))))
